title: Nocturne's template invents no price, date, rating, count, place or testimonial

source.ref: Daniel 2026-11-18: "Make every Frequency theme FULLY generic with copy that coaches them what to write. Be sure anybody using a theme keeps their content but give the templates a full scrub."

detail: Nocturne's template defaults (lib/sites/midnight-home.ts: the block defaults and the editor's Nocturne program template) carried a sample house's facts that an owner would publish as their own: prices ($450 counsel, $12 to $240 tiers, shop and library prices), fixed dates (Nov 18, Dec 2, Mon 3 Nov), star ratings and review counts (4.9 from 318 reviews, 86 reviews), take-up counts (412 have taken it), a named testimonial (Priya N., Founder, Fieldwork), a city (Melbourne, Australia and New Zealand), a founding story (2018) and free or rhythm promises. Each is gone or now says what to write there; the gatherings fallback shows no invented dates and says new ones appear when added. Saved pages keep their own props (block render never reads these defaults), and House of Fates keeps its own seed. Temple Kit's starter Home was already softened (temple-kit-profile-variants.ts SOFTEN) and Services turns any number in a trust line into a prompt.
